brief_rationale: All responsibility chain items are met with no serious or minor errors. The doctor actively queried workspace records, screened for postoperative red flags, established clear follow-up plans with owner/timing/materials, and handled medication safety appropriately. HO2 (misconception correction) is complete with active correction of 'no pain = no follow-up' and 'possible inflammation = final diagnosis' misunderstandings. HO4 (bounded closure) is complete with explicit open-loop mapping, owner/timing for each item, and caregiver receipt. HO1 and HO3 are partial - friction navigation and hidden-state discovery were attempted but not fully integrated into a feasible plan with alternatives. Grade 5 requires two complete high-order points, which is satisfied.
